title: Adds Failed Tax Calculation error
summary: Introduces a new error code and message that’s returned when automatic tax fails to calculate.
migrationNotes: If your integration handles specific error codes from APIs with automatic tax, you must update your error handling logic to also handle the failed_tax_calculation error code, which indicates that the tax calculation couldn’t be completed.
